newsitem.title: USA: Genentech chairman retires, Munro to succeed.
newsitem.headline: Genentech chairman retires, Munro to succeed.

text.p: Genentech Inc said Friday that Chairman Robert Swanson has decided to retire at the end of the year and will be succeeded by company board member Dick Munro.
Swanson co-founded the company in 1976 with Herbert Boyer. He will continue as an adviser and consultant, Genentech said in a release.
Munro, an eight-year member of the Genentech board, is also chairman of the executive committee of the Time Warner Inc board, a director of Mobil Corp, Kellogg Co and K Mart Corp, Genentech said.
